title: Pink Alien on Lava Rock
description: A pink alien creature with large black eyes and a white egg-shaped body covered in red spots stands on a mossy rock. Its pink hands touch the rock while orange lava flows down from the rock into a swirling red and black background with three white spheres floating nearby.
prompt: A pink alien creature with large black eyes a white egg-shaped body covered in red spots and thin pink antennae stands on a moss-covered rocky outcrop. Orange lava flows down the sides of the rock. The background is a swirling pattern of red and black with three white spheres floating in the air. The creature has a small mouth and its pink limbs are touching the mossy rock.
